issue_context.title: disttask: support multiple access point natively
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
For cloud we want to support multiple access endpoints, each of it will have a different `tidb_service_scope`. Apps might connect to different endpoint, dist task submitted from different endpoint should not interference with each other:
1. We want subtasks run on nodes with the same `tidb_service_scope` as the node which submits the job.
2. Make [tidb_enable_dist_task](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/system-variables#tidb_enable_dist_task-new-in-v710) default to true.

although we separate the tasks from tidb side, the pd/tikv is still shared by all endpoints and affects each other.

review_comments: Do we have some test cases for others tidb-service-scope values for example "test1" etc.
In TestTargetScope, we generate random test cases when trigger ci.
Maybe move this to a global variable and initialize it in `init()`?
